Mode

Wallpaper is the planets with the camera slowly going round. Nothing on the picture reacts to clicks, and it goes easy on the battery. Space Scope is where you fly: to any planet or moon, other galaxies, black holes and the planets of other stars. It uses a lot more.

Show

Every planet and moon is where it really is at the time shown. Sizes and distances are squashed so it all fits; directions are real. The stars are made up, but the galaxies and black holes named on the sky are where the real ones are.

Credits: planet maps from NASA, USGS and Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0, resized and recoloured), Natural Earth and Celestia. Positions by astronomy-engine, drawing by three.js. Full list in CREDITS.txt.
